jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern - Python / FastAPI / React.js
jobs.description:
Raysoft.AI is looking for a Full Stack Developer Intern
to join our development team for a 6-month remote internship.
This role is a good fit for a recent graduate with knowledge of Python and React.js who is looking for an opportunity to work on real software products rather than just training or practice assignments.
What you’ll work on

Develop backend APIs using Python and FastAPI
Build and improve frontend features using React.js
Connect frontend applications with backend APIs
Work with SQL databases and third-party APIs
Debug and fix issues in existing applications
Test features and participate in code reviews
Work alongside our development team on AI-powered SaaS products

What we’re looking for

Recent B.Tech/B.E./BCA/MCA or similar graduate
Good understanding of Python
Working knowledge of React.js and JavaScript
Basic understanding of FastAPI or REST APIs
Familiarity with SQL and databases
Comfortable using Git/GitHub
Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
Able to work independently in a remote environment

You do not need extensive professional experience. College projects, personal projects, internships, or a strong GitHub profile will be considered.

Internship Details

Location: Remote – India
Duration: 6 months
Experience: Fresher / 0–1 year
Employment Type: Internship
Candidates who have recently graduated and want hands-on full-stack development experience are encouraged to apply.
